set.body:
Outcome

Protect the retained optimized kernels and new compiler boundaries from performance regression.

Acceptance

- JMH or equivalent separates setup from timed execution on focused JVM paths.
- Receipts count operator applications, materialized doubles, solver iterations, measurements visited, and completed work.
- Reference and optimized comparisons complete equivalent scientific work.
- Scala.js has deterministic scale guards without claiming portable timings.
set.title: P7.4: establish work, allocation, and performance courts for completed work
